name: We the People
direction: The precinct map: your place on the map of your government.
mark: The numerals 305 in heavy sans with 'We the People' in mono caps above; the precinct grid as texture with the user's precinct filled in area green.
rules: Area green means one thing: near you or yours. Never decoration.
Navy and paper carry everything else. No gradients, no rounded corners, no shadows.
Dates and numbers are mono. Headlines are heavy sans caps. Sentences are regular sans.
A date block on the left of a card: green when the item is near you, tinted when it is in your city, paper otherwise.
Every touch target is at least 44px.
tagline: open-source civic intelligence: our government works for us, not the other way around.
